rules: HIGH or CRITICAL risk always routes to LEAD_ONLY.
Open security analysis, code editing, external actions, and unclassified work route to LEAD_ONLY.
Restricted data never leaves the host.
The local lane is admitted only for its exact qualified Python test-extraction class with a qualified adapter and deterministic oracle.
The Cerebras lane is admitted only for bounded structural selection with a qualified adapter, deterministic oracle, no restricted data, and no required external action.
No worker may approve, promote, execute tools, mutate a repository, or weaken a gate.
